title: Luxury new house in downtown Nashville
description:
Welcome to this luxury home hosted by superhost – a striking home with all the modern amenities in a prime location about 1 mile to Iconic Broadway. This thoughtfully designed home offers an amazing experience with family and friends in this mini oasis located in booming North Gultch area! Parks, restaurants, museum, farmers market, grocery stores, and YMCA are in working distance. Excellent downtown view from upper porch. Can park two cars at back alley. Total nine beds, sleeps up to 12 people.

The space
It is two story house. Three bedrooms upstairs and one bedroom downstairs. Two beautiful patios with downtown view.

The entire house will be rented. Maximum for 12 people.

Guest access
Entire house

Other things to note
Towels and beddings will be accommodated by number of guests.
